svg.title: MATH-06 inequality slack, equality, Jensen gap, and log-sum-exp audit
svg.desc: Four scientific panels show Young bound slack versus epsilon, Cauchy normalized inner product versus angle, exponential Jensen gap versus spread, and log-sum-exp max gap versus margin for several dimensions and temperatures.
svg.text: MATH-06 audit · slack, equality geometry, Jensen curvature, and stable log-sum-exp
Finite curves diagnose where a valid bound becomes loose; universal inequalities still require proof.
epsilon=1 gives 10; optimum epsilon=1/3 gives 6 exactly.
Parallel vectors are tight; orthogonal vectors have maximum normalized slack.
Gap is zero only at r=0; curvature turns spread into a positive Jensen gap.
